title: System Explorer estate findings roll-up
description: The hub's findings registry, whole: one list holding CURRENT findings, FROZEN ones (nobody could look), and RESOLVED HISTORY within retention, together by design — reappearance within retention is the same finding recurring, and history that vanished would be suppression. A consumer reading this cold must band on two members before anything else: observable=false means frozen (no `current` claim exists, because nobody can currently say), observable=true splits on current true/false — and current:false rows are deliberate history, not a registry leak (misread exactly that way by a careful consumer on day one, 2026-08-13). Acknowledged findings stay in this list, marked: suppression is the one power the design refuses to create. Shared $defs are duplicated from findings.schema.json deliberately so each schema file is standalone.

swept_at.description: When the sweep behind this answer completed. The read serves the latest completed sweep instantly (the hub sweeps on its own cadence); this stamp is the staleness, stated rather than hidden.

writes_enabled.description: Whether this deployment granted the transition route (findingsWrites). Surfaced so a consumer can offer acknowledgement only where it exists.

findings.description: Sorted attention-first: current findings (critical before warn), then frozen, then resolved history. Band on observable and current before reading anything else.

swept.description: Whether this agent's /v1/findings answered. False covers a dark host and an agent predating the surface alike — the error text distinguishes them, and either way its registry findings freeze rather than resolve.

swept_at.description: When THIS host was last asked, which is not necessarily when the envelope was assembled. Agents can be on different cadences — a sweep budget sizes each host's interval from its own measured cost — so one stamp across the document would report a host swept ten minutes ago as current, the precise failure 'last-known-good belongs with findings' exists to prevent. Absent on a hub predating the field, and then the envelope's own swept_at is the only answer.

evidence_ref.description: Agent-relative; a hub consumer reaches it through /agents/{agent}.

observable.description: Whether the estate could currently look where this finding lives. False freezes the lifecycle and withholds `current`.

current.description: Derived this sweep (true) or observed absent by an agent that could look (false). Never present when observable is false.

acknowledged.description: The latest appended transition is an acknowledgement. Styling hint only: an acknowledged finding is never removed from this list or any projection.

look.description: Where to look next, carried verbatim from the agent's opinion. The routes address the AGENT that raised the finding, not the hub: a consumer reaches them through /agents/{agent} exactly as it reaches evidence_ref. See observation.schema.json for why this is not a filter.

fact.description: The fact that ORDERS the answer at that route. Absent when no single fact ranks it.

label.description: The human phrase the link is worded with.
